title: Five-Part Agent Harness Architecture and Four-Mechanism Reliability Invariant
author: Brain Harness Reflector

claims.assertion: An agent harness is the opinionated runtime shell wrapped around an LLM prediction core, providing the ReAct loop, tool router, memory management, planning gate, and sandbox boundary.
claims.source: freeCodeCamp: 'What Is an Agent Harness' by Rudrendu Paul (2026-09-17) + Yao et al. ReAct (2022)

claims.assertion: Reliable multi-turn agent execution requires four load-bearing mechanisms: a pre-execution planning tool, virtual filesystem and sandbox isolation, subagent delegation with isolated context windows, and context compression middleware.
claims.source: Claude Code Architecture + LangChain Deep Agents (2026) + deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

claims.assertion: Production agent architectures partition into four distinct decoupled layers: Protocol Layer (MCP), Harness Loop, Orchestration Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AG2, Mastra), and Observability/Sandboxing (Langfuse, E2B, Modal).
claims.source: Model Context Protocol (Linux Foundation / Anthropic 2024-2026) + E2B + Langfuse Tracing
